name: claude-code-sound-alerts
description: Customizable Claude Code sound alerts with dynamic multi-window listeners, Question/Finished primary alerts, presets, volume boost, repeats, and per-event controls.

claudeSoundAlerts.enabled.description: Enable the local listener and sound alerts.

claudeSoundAlerts.serverPort.description: Starting localhost port for dynamic listeners. Each VS Code window automatically uses the first free port from this value upward.

claudeSoundAlerts.listenerPortCount.description: Number of localhost ports available for simultaneous VS Code listener instances. Each window automatically picks a free port.

claudeSoundAlerts.questionSoundEnabled.description: Play the question sound when Claude needs your input.
claudeSoundAlerts.questionSoundEnabled.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSoundEnabled.description: Play the finished sound when Claude completes a response.
claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSoundEnabled.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnAskUserQuestion.description: Alert immediately when Claude uses AskUserQuestion.
claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnAskUserQuestion.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnPermissionReque.description: Alert immediately when Claude asks for tool permission.
claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnPermissionReque.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnPlanApproval.description: Alert when Claude asks you to approve exiting plan mode.
claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnPlanApproval.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnMcpElicitation.description: Alert when an MCP server asks for user input.
claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnMcpElicitation.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnBackgroundInput.description: Alert when a background Claude agent reports that it needs input.
claudeSoundAlerts.alertOnBackgroundInput.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.questionSoundPath.description: Path to a custom PCM WAV file used when Question Sound is set to Custom.
claudeSoundAlerts.questionSoundPath.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSoundPath.description: Path to a custom PCM WAV file used when Finished Sound is set to Custom.
claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSoundPath.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.debounceMs.description: Suppress duplicate alerts of the same type inside this time window.

claudeSoundAlerts.showVisualNotification.description: Also show a VS Code information notification when an alert fires.

claudeSoundAlerts.questionVolume.description: Question/attention sound volume from 0 to 200 percent.
claudeSoundAlerts.questionVolume.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedVolume.description: Finished sound volume from 0 to 200 percent.
claudeSoundAlerts.finishedVolume.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.questionSound.description: Sound used for question/attention alerts. The control panel is the easiest way to change this.
claudeSoundAlerts.questionSound.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSound.description: Sound used for finished alerts. The control panel is the easiest way to change this.
claudeSoundAlerts.finishedSound.deprecationMessage: Use the v1.3 Claude Sound Alerts control panel. This setting is retained for v1.2 migration.

claudeSoundAlerts.eventSettings.description: Per-event alert settings managed by the Claude Sound Alerts control panel.

claudeSoundAlerts.watchedFiles.description: Literal filenames to watch for Claude Code FileChanged alerts, for example .env or package.json. Reinstall hooks after changing this list.

claudeSoundAlerts.repeatGapMs.description: Pause in milliseconds between repeated alert sounds.
